failure_modes: Thin model: the hidden uses of existing assets are never searched for
Collecting options beyond what the system can afford
Optimising an asset for its obvious purpose and destroying its buffer role, as with stock cut to free working capital
gloss: The risk-management uses hidden inside assets whose obvious purpose is something else
invariants: Each tactic is either absorption or evasion
Evasion always requires an option held before the shock
mechanism: Almost every asset an organism or organisation holds also manages risk. The exoskeleton is built from two tactics. Shock absorption buffers a hit, as homeostasis does through {{active_inference_homeostasis}} and fat reserves do through famine. Shock evasion keeps options that sidestep the hit, which comes down to holding several models in the manner of {{meta_modularity}}. Every option has a carrying cost, so the task is to hold as many as the system can afford to maintain.
